one_line: Phone unboxing and page flips on a table, hooked by one emotional moment: the child sees their name.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 closed white MeBook.ai box lid, top-down, no person; 0:02 the lid opens and the cover shows. Voice from 0:00 (transcript): "יש רגע כזה שהילד פותח ספר". First subtitle, 0:01: "יש רגע כזה שהילד פותח ספר,".
q1_hook.why: It opens on a concrete moment, a child seeing their own name, not a greeting (H1), with a voice from 0:00 (H4) and an unboxing motion at 0:02 (E1). But the first frame is a closed box with a logo and no text (S1, T3), so the cover only shows at 0:03.

beats.what: Closed MeBook.ai box lid; the lid opens at 0:02; "יש רגע כזה שהילד פותח ספר,"
beats.why: Unboxing motion plus the promise of a moment

beats.what: Cover close-up on a table; "ופתאום הוא ראה את השם שלו שם," then "אימא זה אני!"
beats.why: The promised line arrives at 0:07, but over a cover, not a child

beats.what: Book open flat, farm picture and a text page; "אמיץ, חכם, מיוחד, זו לא רק מתנה,"
beats.why: Shows the inside while the brand claim is spoken

beats.what: A hand turns pages; blurred flips through dinner and garden pictures; "זו חוויה שמחזקת ביטחון,"
beats.why: Page motion keeps the eye busy during a list of benefits

beats.what: Box side with a printed Hebrew line; "כי כשהילד שלך הוא הגיבור," "הקסם מתחיל באמת, מי בוק."
beats.why: Closing line and brand name over an object-only shot

beats.what: Camera drifts along the box and table; no subtitle, no speech in the transcript
beats.why: A silent tail after the last word

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, send-worthy tip or ask to comment, share or save in the video or the caption, only a coupon line.
q2_flow.why: A new shot every 2 to 7 s and the page flips keep the middle moving (R3, F8), but the benefits are a spoken list over similar page shots, with no reaction or person (R3). The last 3 s add nothing after the closing line (R1).

q3_cta.what: None in the video; it ends on a brand sign-off, subtitled "הקסם מתחיל באמת, מי בוק." Caption line 3: "קוד קופון:mayah". No comment word, link or question.
q3_cta.why: One ask only, a coupon code (C1), and it is a real benefit (C2). But it sits only in the caption: the video never says or shows it, so after the closing line the viewer has no next step (C6).

q4_shown.what: Closed MeBook.ai box 0:00-0:02; cover close-ups 0:03-0:08; the book open flat and page flips through farm, dinner and garden pictures 0:09-0:20; the box side with a printed Hebrew line 0:20-0:27. No person, child, price, photo or screen recording.
q4_shown.why: Hands-only object filming can carry a Reel (S4), but here the main claim, a child seeing their name, is only said: no name, photo or reaction is shown to check it (S2, S8). No first-hand voice, only brand adjectives (S6).

q5_edit.what: 7 shots in 27.7 s, about 4 s each. Hard cuts, no speed ramps; natural blur on page flips 0:16-0:20. Subtitles change every 1 to 4 s. Speech stops at about 0:24, then 3 s of silent drift to the end.
q5_edit.why: A cut by 1.1 s and then 2 to 7 s shots keep a moderate pace (E1, E2). Subtitles follow the voice (E4). The 3 s silent tail after the last word is dead time (E8, R1).

q6_topic.what: A scripted pitch: seeing your own name makes a child the hero, and builds confidence and reading. It serves a parent who wants a meaningful gift.
q6_topic.why: The "אמא זה אני" line is the one emotional beat (K1). The claims "מחזקת ביטחון, מעודדת קריאה" come as a list, not inside a story or a reaction, and are not checkable (K4). There is no character on screen, so no mini story (K2).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld high-angle close-ups on a wooden table in daylight: the box lid, the cover, the open book. A hand shows only at 0:14-0:16 for a page turn. A low drift along the box side at the end. No person, no face, no child.
q7_filmed.why: A hand on the page appears only for a moment (F5). With no hand or voice of a person on screen it reads as brand b-roll, not a creator's own moment (H8). Glossy covers throw glare (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles with a thin shadow, one short phrase at a time, about 83% down the frame: "יש רגע כזה שהילד פותח ספר," (0:01), "ופתאום הוא ראה את השם שלו שם," (0:03), "אימא זה אני!" (0:07), "אמיץ, חכם, מיוחד, זו לא רק מתנה," (0:11), "זו חוויה שמחזקת ביטחון," (0:15), "הקסם מתחיל באמת, מי בוק." (0:23). None in the last 3 s. No headline card.
q8_text.caption: The first line names the brand, "מי בוק", and says "הספר שמספר את הסיפור שלך" with a sparkle emoji. Four short lines, about 20 words: a tagline, "קוד קופון:mayah", then "בשיתוף:@mebook.ai". No question, no hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles mirror the voice in short chunks, so it works muted (T1, T2), but they sit inside the bottom 35% and cover the printed cover title at 0:03 (T4, F2). No headline names the topic (T3). The caption has no occasion or parent search words (T7); the partnership is on the last line (T8).

weak_points: The main claim is only said, no name or child shown; adjectives and developmental claims in a list; a closed box for 2 s; subtitles over the cover title; a silent 3 s tail; the code only in the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the box opening and top-down page flips, no child. Add what is missing here: your own first-person line, and a photo placed beside the page with the name.
not_verified: Whether music plays; whether the voice is the creator's. Corrections to coded file: a hand shows at 0:14-0:16, so not fully object-only; the cover title "כיף בחוות החיות" is fully readable and is not a child's name; the subtitle "הקסם" is right, the transcript's "הכסף" is a mishearing. The story text on a page holds a name, unreadable at phone size, not quoted. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
